testEffect: Weakening `expect(applyDiscount(100.05, 10)).toBe(90.05)` to `expect(applyDiscount(100.05, 10)).toBeGreaterThan(0)` accepts any positive number instead of verifying precise rounding.
productionEffect: Corrupting `applyDiscount` to truncate cents using `Math.floor` instead of rounding is expected to fail this test as written; substituting the weaker inequality assertion would allow the regression to pass.
